audits.notes: First audit, on the 19-trial benchmark: every number matching the hand-verified file, a random sample, and 16 review-queue items. 96/100 published numbers correct. Systematic error found: non-standard time endpoints (second PFS, PFS on treatment, failure-free survival, duration of disease control) filed as PFS/TTP; fixed with a new measure and a code check on the quote and the record's detail.
